description: Use this when a user asks what compulsory basic health insurance costs per month under the approved tariffs, for example for an adult in a region with a given deductible, in Switzerland (country CH), Hong Kong (VHIS Standard Plans) (country HK) or United States marketplace plans (country US). Returns the median monthly premium with the typical range (10th to 90th percentile) across the insurers' approved tariffs, the number of tariffs behind it, the period, a confidence label, and the official source and licence. These are posted list tariffs approved by the regulator, the same for everyone in a region and age group, not amounts paid by individuals and not a personal quote. How fresh: Switzerland: once a year: premiums for the next year are approved and published in September; Hong Kong (VHIS Standard Plans): updated as and when necessary by the Health Bureau (file last modified 27 Oct 2026); our copy is collected daily; United States marketplace plans: once a year: plan-year files are published in autumn (plan year 2026 files last modified 10 Aug 2026). Do not use for a personal quote, for supplementary or private cover, or for countries not listed.

accident.description: Whether accident cover is included in the premium. Default: without for adults and young adults, with for children. HK: not used. US: not used.

age.description: US only: the person's age in years (18 to 63 give their own rate; 64 and over share one; 0-14 share the child rate).

age_group.description: Age group: adult (26+, default), young_adult (19-25) or child (0-18). HK: adult = age 40 (default), young_adult = age 21, child = age 10; or give the exact insured_age. US: adult = age 40 (default), young_adult = age 21, child = 0-14; or…

area.description: Region (see the country notes), e.g. a canton code such as 'ZH'. Leave out for the whole country. CH: a canton code (AG, AI, AR, BE, BL, BS, FR, GE, GL, GR, JU, LU, NE, NW, OW, SG, SH, SO, SZ, TG, TI, UR, VD, VS, ZG, ZH); leave out for…

country.description: CH = Switzerland (compulsory basic health insurance); HK = Hong Kong (Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme, standard premiums of certified Standard Plans); US = United States (ACA marketplace plans, HealthCare.gov states)

franchise.description: Annual deductible in local currency; the values available depend on the country notes. Default: the lowest one for the age group. CH: adults and young adults 300, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000 or 2500 CHF; children 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or…

insured_age.description: HK only: the insured person's age in years (0 to 99).

metal_level.description: US only: marketplace metal level. Default silver.

model.description: standard = free choice of doctor (default); alternative = family-doctor, telemedicine or HMO models with a restricted choice. HK: not used. US: not used.

policy_type.description: HK only: standalone (default) or rider policy.

smoker.description: HK only: smoker yes or no (default no).
